name: YS Desk: Live Chat, Chatbot, Chat Widget, Helpdesk, Customer Support & Support Chat
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
YS Desk is a live chat and helpdesk plugin for WordPress. It adds a chat widget to your site so visitors can message you directly, and gives your team a shared inbox to reply from, assign conversations, and track how support is going. If you’ve been searching for a live chat plugin, a chatbot for your website, or a simple helpdesk tool that doesn’t need a developer to set up, this covers all three.

Setup takes a few minutes. You install the plugin, paste in a token from your YS Desk account, and the chat widget appears on your site. No developer needed, and no code to edit.

Get started for free at https://www.ysdesk.com

Why teams use YS Desk

  • Faster replies to visitors, often within the first week of setup
  • Average customer satisfaction rating of 4.7 out of 5 across workspaces
  • Full visibility into who on your team is handling which conversation
  • Most teams are live and chatting with their first visitor in under 10 minutes

What’s included

Shared inbox
Every conversation started through the chat widget lands in one inbox, so nobody has to dig through email or check five different tabs.

Customizable chat widget
Change the colors, position, launcher style, and welcome message so the widget matches your site instead of looking bolted on.

Visitor details
When someone starts a chat, your team can see their email, what page they’re on, their browser, and their past conversations without having to ask.

Conversation statuses
Every chat is marked as open, waiting for customer, waiting for agent, or closed, so it’s obvious what needs attention.

Team collaboration
Assign a conversation to a teammate, reassign it, or leave an internal note with an @mention. Internal notes are never visible to the customer.

Roles and permissions
Decide who can view and reply to conversations with role based permissions for agents and admins.

Analytics and reports
See conversation volume, response times, CSAT scores, and agent performance in a dashboard that updates in real time.

Live agent status
See which agents are online, how many chats they’re handling, and who’s free to take the next one.

Lightweight widget
The chat script loads asynchronously in the background, so it doesn’t slow down your page.

New in this version

Billing and subscriptions
Free, trial, and paid plans with upgrades, downgrades, and both domestic and international payment options. Invoices, payment history, and billing emails are all handled automatically.

Workspace permissions
More detailed role based access control, permission templates you can reuse, and permission changes that apply instantly without anyone needing to log out and back in. Workspace ownership can now be transferred by email with an accept or decline flow.

Chat experience improvements
Support sessions for logged in users, live agent status updates inside conversations, messages that appear instantly before the server confirms them, file downloads from within the chat, friendlier names for anonymous visitors, and a more accurate live monitor for tracking visitors as they become customers.

Fixes and performance
Unread counts are more accurate, duplicate welcome messages on reconnect are gone, analytics numbers line up correctly, and chat rendering, real time updates, and background jobs all run faster and use less memory.

Security
Centralized permission checks, instant permission syncing across the workspace, webhook signature verification, and stronger enforcement against blocked users and spoofed events.

Where YS Desk works well

  • Online stores wanting to catch customers before they abandon their cart
  • SaaS products answering onboarding and account questions
  • Healthcare practices handling patient questions securely
  • Financial services building trust during sign up and account setup
  • Logistics companies keeping customers updated without email threads
  • Agencies managing multiple clients from one inbox
  • Schools and universities answering admissions questions

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect or store any personal data on your WordPress site. Chat conversations and customer data are handled securely by YS Desk services.

Full details are available at https://ysdesk.com/privacy-policy

Support

Website: https://ysdesk.com
Support: Reach out through your YS Desk dashboard or visit https://ysdesk.com
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins, then Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for YS Desk, or upload the plugin ZIP file
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Open YS Desk Chat from the admin sidebar
  5. Paste in your token from https://ysdesk.com
  6. Click Save Changes and the widget will appear on your site
sections.faq:
What is YS Desk?

YS Desk is a live chat plugin for WordPress. It lets visitors message you directly from your site, and your team replies from a shared inbox instead of juggling email.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. You just paste your token into the settings page and the widget starts working on its own.

Where do I find my token?

Sign up at https://ysdesk.com and your token is in the workspace settings section of your dashboard.

Will the chat widget slow down my site?

No. The script loads in the background after your page has already loaded, so it doesn’t hold anything up.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes, YS Desk works with any standard WordPress theme without extra setup.

What happens if I forget to add a token?

The widget simply won’t show up until a valid token is entered. Nothing else on your site is affected.

Can more than one person on my team use it?

Yes. YS Desk is built for teams, with a shared inbox, roles and permissions, conversation assignment, @mentions, and live status for each agent.

Does YS Desk track analytics?

Yes. You get real time numbers on conversations, response times, CSAT scores, missed chats, and how each agent is performing.

What kind of businesses use this?

E-commerce stores, SaaS companies, healthcare providers, financial services, logistics companies, agencies, and schools, among others.

Is there a free plan?

Yes. You can start using YS Desk for free at https://www.ysdesk.com and no card is required.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Added Google Maps and Geocoding integration with multi-tier fallback (GPS, mobile browser, and IP) for high-accuracy visitor location tracking.
  • Added customizable pre-chat form visibility settings to easily toggle intake forms on or off per channel.
  • Added configurable workspace inactivity timeouts with flexible intervals and a “Never” option to prevent unwanted auto-logouts.
  • Added advanced search, category filtering, and pagination to the canned responses and categories management pages.
  • Added real-time checkout status polling and instant payment confirmation for seamless plan upgrades.
  • Added an informative disabled preview state for CSAT surveys in the chat widget when customer satisfaction surveys are deactivated.
  • Added a centralized platform event architecture with runtime schema validation for reliable real-time synchronization across services.
  • Improved visitor geolocation accuracy with intelligent location quality scoring, persistent GPS reuse, and refined movement thresholds.
  • Improved canned responses collaboration by defaulting template visibility to workspace-wide public access.
  • Improved chatbox customizer with comprehensive dark mode styling across branding, launchers, welcome messages, and offline forms.
  • Improved client IP extraction and trust verification across reverse proxies, CDNs, and load balancers.
  • Improved agent session activity tracking with clearer idle timeout notifications and automatic reconnection sync.
  • Improved billing checkout experience with expanded plan feature breakdowns and polished UI elements.
  • Improved widget startup and channel settings caching with optimized HTTP cache-control headers.
  • Fixed pre-chat form persistence by automatically clearing cached visitor identity and resetting input fields upon conversation resolution.
  • Fixed message cross-talk by strictly isolating incoming messages to their respective active conversations.
  • Fixed location drift and unnecessary GPS updates by increasing client movement sensitivity thresholds.
  • Fixed payment status delays after checkout completion through automated status polling.
  • Strengthened platform security with asymmetric key verification and assertion checks for cross-service administrative access.
  • Strengthened multi-tenant isolation and data boundaries across canned responses, user histories, and workspace events.
  • Strengthened authorization performance with centralized permission template caching.

1.0.2

  • Added billing and subscriptions with free, trial, and paid plans, upgrades and downgrades, and support for domestic and international payment methods
  • Added a fuller billing dashboard with invoices, payment history, and automated billing emails
  • Added more detailed role based permissions with reusable templates and instant syncing across the workspace
  • Added the ability to transfer workspace ownership by email
  • Added support sessions for logged in users and live agent status inside conversations
  • Added instant message display before the server confirms delivery
  • Added file downloads from within chat conversations
  • Added friendlier auto generated names for anonymous visitors
  • Improved accuracy of the live monitor when visitors become customers
  • Fixed unread count inconsistencies and duplicate welcome messages on reconnect
  • Fixed analytics inaccuracies in visitor counts and conversation metrics
  • Improved chat rendering speed, real time updates, and background job reliability
  • Strengthened security with centralized permission checks and webhook signature verification

1.0.1

  • Added live location mapping so agents can see visitor locations on a map
  • Improved multi tab session syncing for more accurate presence tracking
  • Added glassmorphism and neumorphic widget theme options
  • Added more control over widget positioning
  • Improved file upload reliability on slow connections
  • Fixed race conditions affecting message delivery and file sharing

1.0.0

  • Initial release
